title: Manual of the Skipping Step
summary: A manual on skipping across the gap between two points in quick short hops and striking between them.

title: Treatise on Pleated Distance
summary: A treatise on gathering space into narrow pleats that shorten a stride and deepen a guard.

title: Course of the Mirrored Image
summary: A course in casting the user's likeness into a second place in space so a foe strikes the wrong one.

title: The Lattice Reading
summary: A reading of the fine lattice that frames each stretch of space and the points where it can be pinned or cut.

title: Workbook of Gap and Seam
summary: A workbook on finding the seam in a foe's defence and the gap in the space about them and driving through both.

title: Handbook of the Inward Draw
summary: A handbook on drawing the space about a foe inward so their limbs and weapons fold toward the user.

title: Course in Spiral Reach
summary: A course in turning the body through a spiral of space so each blow comes in from the far side.
